artifacts.summary: 4-phase (3.0h) verification-and-closure plan for task 736: acceptance-gate re-verification at HEAD, bounded acquisition attempt on three still-WANTED sources, comment-only E3 re-audit annotation on device-selection-probe.lean, summary with operator hand-off list.

memory_candidates.content: When a research dispatch's own deliverables already satisfy every one of a task's acceptance items (report written, index wired and validated, evidence probe compiling and wired into the gate, claims re-verified), the correct shape for the following implement round is a VERIFICATION-AND-CLOSURE round, not an invented build round. Three phases carry it: (1) re-run every acceptance gate at the new round's HEAD rather than citing the research dispatch's recorded run, because shared gate files have other live writers; (2) record the finding at the UPSTREAM RECORD'S OWN SITE (e.g. append a comment-only re-audit block to the earlier probe whose claims were falsified) so the verdict is discoverable from the record a roadmap cites, instead of living only inside a task directory; (3) write an explicit operator hand-off list naming each finding deliberately NOT acted on together with the reason (another task's live file_scope, a missing roadmap_flag, the source-store/deploy boundary). The anti-pattern this replaces is padding such a round with speculative work, or silently dropping the un-actioned findings.
